items.name: origin/origin-button
items.title: OriginButton
items.description: Unstyled accessible action primitive providing safe `<button>` defaults (`type="button"`), optional non-anchor tag rendering (`as`), keyboard activation, focusable `aria-disabled`, and declarative Invoker/Popover triggers.

items.name: origin/origin-link
items.title: OriginLink
items.description: Unstyled accessible navigation primitive rendering a genuine `<a>` element without ever overriding link semantics with `role="button"`.

items.name: origin/origin-dialog
items.title: OriginDialog
items.description: Unstyled native modal dialog primitive using Invoker Commands; the browser owns focus containment, inert page, Escape dismissal and focus restoration.

items.name: origin/origin-input
items.title: OriginInput
items.description: Unstyled native text input with a bound label, persistent hint and native constraint attributes.

items.name: origin/origin-popover
items.title: OriginPopover
items.description: Unstyled native Popover API surface with declarative triggers, conditional polyfill loading and optional focus return to the trigger.

items.name: origin/origin-select
items.title: OriginSelect
items.description: Unstyled native select with a bound label and optional persistent hint; no custom listbox role invention.

items.name: origin/origin-tabs
items.title: OriginTabs
items.description: Unstyled headless tabs using native focusgroup with a roving-focus fallback; tabs and panels are supplied via named slots.

items.name: liftoff/button
items.title: Button
items.description: Themed, copy-paste action button built atop OriginButton. Adds semantic token variants, sizes, hover/press/focus states, and WCAG 2.5.8 / 2.5.5 minimum target sizing. For URL navigation, use LinkButton instead.

items.name: liftoff/link-button
items.title: LinkButton
items.description: Themed navigation link built atop OriginLink. Applies Button visual variants and sizes to a genuine `<a>` element without ever overriding link semantics with `role="button"`.

items.name: liftoff/blocks
items.title: Blocks
items.description: Themed section wrapper for CMS block sequences.

items.name: liftoff/byline
items.title: Byline
items.description: Themed author/date metadata row.

items.name: liftoff/pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Themed previous/next navigation with real links.

items.name: liftoff/portable-text
items.title: PortableText
items.description: Themed container for normalized portable-text blocks supplied through the default slot.

items.name: liftoff/post-card
items.title: PostCard
items.description: Themed article teaser card with a real navigation link.

items.name: liftoff/prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Themed long-form article container with semantic heading rhythm.

items.name: liftoff/table-of-contents
items.title: TableOfContents
items.description: Themed table-of-contents navigation built from consumer-supplied anchor links.

items.name: liftoff/badge
items.title: Badge

items.name: liftoff/card
items.title: Card
items.description: Themed surface container styled entirely with semantic tokens.

items.name: liftoff/dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Themed native modal dialog built atop OriginDialog.

items.name: liftoff/input
items.title: Input
items.description: Themed text input built atop OriginInput with semantic token styling.

items.name: liftoff/popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Themed native popover built atop OriginPopover.

items.name: liftoff/select
